name: Arctic Fox
body:
ARCTIC FOX
CR 1/3

This small, sharp-toothed predator has long, lush white fur, ending in a bushy tail.

XP 133
N Tiny animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +8

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 14, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 size)
hp 6 (1d8+2)
Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +1
Resist cold 5

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +1 (1d3-1)
Space 2-1/2 ft.; Reach 0 ft.
Special Attacks sneak attack +1d3

STATISTICS

Str 9, Dex 15, Con 14, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Atk +0; CMB +0; CMD 9 (13 vs. trip)
Feats Endurance
Skills Acrobatics +2 (+10 when jumping), Perception +5, Stealth +10 (+14 in snow and ice), Survival +1 (+5 scent tracking); Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics when jumping, +4 Stealth in snowy or icy terrain, +4 Survival when tracking by scent

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Sure-footed (Ex)

An arctic fox does not treat snow or ice as difficult terrain and ignores the increased DC for slippery terrain due to snow and ice.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or skulk (3-12)
Treasure none

Foxes are small, clever predators with long, lush fur that keeps them warm even in extreme cold, with especially bushy tails. The coloration of an arctic fox helps it them camouflage well in snowy or icy terrain to ambush their prey. Some arctic foxes’ coloration shifts during the summer to gray or pale brown, while others remain snowy-white year-round. Foxes burrow into snowbanks to hide and keep warm in stormy weather and dig out earthen dens where they raise their kits.
